month_notes: Nha Trang’s wettest month, but both winter markets are starting. Russian charters build through October, and from the 25th the winter schedule lands eleven Korean flights between 20:20 and 00:35 — the day’s heaviest stretch is late at night.
empty_band_note: Only one international arrival all afternoon

context.text: Cam Ranh handled 6.8 million passengers in 2024, of whom 4.2 million were international, and international traffic grew again to roughly 4.69 million in 2025. Terminal 2 takes all international arrivals.
context.source: Bao Khanh Hoa, Dec 2024; Aviation Week, 2026

basis: based on flight schedules and the airport’s published passenger numbers from 2024–2026
